aws_image_qualification: Tools installed only in newly owned disposable staging allocations. Product requires dependencies and plugin baked into the pinned image. All workload/capture/restore commands use the agent lane.
controller: separate CayuApp processes; SQLiteSessionStore; private LocalArtifactStore; source removed before restoration
managed_workload: one cooperative pre-launched Python process with threads, memory, local listener and owned regular files/directories
source_hash_scope: Adapter, guest, plugin, typed manifest, image recipe and live fixture sources used in qualification. Host lifecycle and native-store integration additionally validated by the repository conformance and runtime tests.
timing_scope: Single samples. Capture includes engine capture, bounded transfer, private artifact-store verification and durable publication. Restore includes artifact reads/verification, transfer, restart and durable activation. Allocation/image bootstrap excluded. No cross-backend speed or general workload claim.
